# Chronux 2.12 (subset)

Only the 9 files this pipeline calls, copied unchanged from Chronux 2.12
(http://chronux.org). Chronux is distributed under the GNU General Public
License v2. The full toolbox is not needed.

Used by: `05_coherence` (`mtspecgramc`, `mtfftc`, `two_group_test_coherence`)
and `07_age_varying_spectrogram` (`mtspecgramc`, `mtspectrumc`).
